palette.notes: Pure black and white, a self-imposed limit by the team (per the wiki); the gameplay frames confirm only black and white. The black field dominates; white is used for lines, shapes and dither.

lighting: No light modelling; everything depends on figure-ground: white shapes on black, with interiors shown as small white-lined rooms floating in black.
silhouette: Tiny duck-like hero (a white blob with a sword) and objects as bold white shapes; rocks are round white blobs that form walls, plants are tiny clustered marks, fences are dashed lines.

motion.timing: No metrics file. Each life lasts 60 seconds (40 in Second Run) per the wiki; the frames show screen-by-screen moves with the hero returning to the starting house again and again (seen at ~7, 27, 32 and 52 s of one clip).

texture: Checker dither on crates and blocks, line hatching on the roof and fences; otherwise solid black fields.
camera: Top-down, flip-screen: each screen is a small room; interiors show as a framed room in a black void.
sound: Music split into roughly one-minute segments that loop into the next track when the hero dies (per the wiki).

acting.enters: Wakes at the house (or last save) at the start of each life; the same house screen recurs in the frames.
acting.acts: Runs a short errand across a few screens, meets odd characters, picks up an item.
acting.exits: Dies when the timer runs out, mid-action, and is sent back.
acting.depth: Single plane; the same screens repeat, so progress shows as small changes in a familiar place rather than as depth.

techniques: 1-bit black and white with shape-only readability
checker dither as the only texture
timed loop: leave, return to the same spot, try again with new progress
the same home screen as a recurring anchor shot
music segmented to the loop length
feel: 1-bit palette + bold tiny shapes + same home screen every 60 s = readable, funny persistence
for_fred: Give Fred a home shot (the same framing every time) and build the reel on returns: he leaves, comes back to that exact frame, tries again with one visible change, leaves again. Each return advances the gag, never repeats it identically.
